alt: 曾經創作出許多作品的作者坐在桌前，握著筆卻想不出內容，眼前的稿紙仍然空白。
scene_prompt: 江郎才盡 means a formerly talented writer's creativity has run dry. Modern adult author at a desk, sitting with pencil poised over a completely BLANK manuscript page, one hand resting against forehead in creative frustration. Around the desk are a few crumpled blank draft sheets; behind him shelves display many previously finished ORIGINAL illustrated books with richly varied colorful covers, showing a successful creative past. A very faint empty pencil thought cloud over his head emphasizes no new ideas, not sleepiness or physical illness. No readable text or letters anywhere, book covers have only generic original landscapes and simple decorative motifs. Gentle empathetic mood, not despair, no famous book designs or celebrity likeness.
